note: WS-1 QA fixture (F8-S1 anchor drift formula). PRE-SHAPED, same convention as synthetic-basic.json. fetched_at is deliberately in the past (owner ruling 1). Two comps, deliberately at different cohort years with different psf, so the drift-compounding exponent (currentYear - cohortYear, currentYear read from the pull's as_of/fetched_at year = 2026) is distinguishable from a plain undrifted median. See backend/tests/api/test_ws1_anchor_drift.py for the worked values. ROW 10B: every comp also states first_listed -- the stitched start date real shaping always sets (pipeline/shape.py::_build_comp) and the date removed_on, and therefore DerivedComp.days_since_removal, is measured from. Without it a removed comp went over the wire carrying a removal rung beside a null count, i.e. the row 'removed nulld -- classifying', while responses.py declares that field null IFF removal_class is null. first_listed is not free: cohort_year is its year, removed_on is it plus effective_dom, and the removal rung is the ladder applied to as_of minus removed_on -- so the pre-shaped format lets an author state one fact four times, which is how they drifted apart. backend/tests/unit/test_r10b_preshaped_pulls_are_shapeable.py re-ties them, over this directory's listing rather than a fixed list of filenames, so a new pre-shaped pull is covered the day it is added. Both comps' stated rungs and cohort years already agreed with a real start date, so nothing else here changed.
